description: The sixth layer of the track: who may do what with which AI, and how you prove it. A stack of controls, each with an owner, enforcement and evidence.
Checking a rule where the action happens (gateway, harness, CI) instead of only writing it in a policy document.
Rules nobody enforces: documents and committees with no runtime check and no evidence that the rule holds.
The audit log, eval record, report or review that proves a control ran. Without it a control cannot be shown to an auditor or regulator.
Volatile legal facts (obligations, dates, statuses) kept as data with an as-of date and a review schedule, separate from the controls they inform.
